sections.line: From Lovable to your own newsroom
sections.para: A brief for José Bota and his agent: Lovable apps to GitHub Pages, a domain with his name and a subdomain per app, a newsroom on the same domain, success as two or three links, and a business in agents' reach.

sections.label: The work, and the business
